crossRefs.note: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?
I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand; but I will break the arms of Pharaoh…
I will hold up the arms of the king of Babylon; and the arms of Pharaoh will fall down. Then they will know that I am…
Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
For you have armed me with strength for the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
“Isn’t Yahweh your God with you? Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the…
Yahweh says: “The labor of Egypt, and the merchandise of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to…
For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.
He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,
who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which…
Our pursuers are on our necks. We are weary, and have no rest.
Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
He who hates me, hates my Father also.
